name: real-for-time-run-swapped-onto-boards-own-bike-20261008
description: SURGE: 3 RFT with its own 18 cal Echo Bike, and the 300m run swapped to 900 m on the Echo Bike in chat. Two bike lines on one board: the board's own (54 cal) and the swapped run (2,700 m). The save used to fold them into ONE breakdown row filed as calories, so the poster hung '⇄ Run' on the calorie line and gave neither bike a total. Breakdown here is what the save writes since the fix.
